flips.ctx_rule: The common controls identified in Table D-2 are based on the following assumptions:
flips.clause: -  Common controls may be allocated at the organization, mission/business process, or information system level.

flips.ctx_rule: The common controls identified in Table D-2 are based on the following assumptions:
flips.clause: -  Organizations have established services (e.g. enterprise, local) that implement technical security controls other information systems can inherit.

flips.ctx_rule: The common controls identified in Table D-2 are based on the following assumptions:
flips.clause: -  Information systems are located in physical facilities that provide physical security services (e.g., guns, gates, and guards, climate control, fire suppression).

flips.ctx_rule: The common controls identified in Table D-2 are based on the following assumptions:
flips.clause: -  Authorization boundaries have been established for controlled interfaces that do not include the interconnected information systems.

flips.ctx_rule: The common controls identified in Table D-2 are based on the following assumptions:
flips.clause: -  A single authorization boundary will be established for a cloud-based enterprise.
